mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can impair levodopa efficacy and increase CNS side effects; amphotericin B may also increase levodopa's peripheral conversion and CNS penetration.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and Parkinson's symptom control during concurrent use; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly and consider levodopa dose adjustment if needed.
